text:
Maya: Heads-up: Enterprise prospect asked for a pilot — per-tenant customer-managed KMS, dedicated capacity, and firm perf targets. Need cross-team alignment on what "pilot" actually contains.
Priya: Customer timeline? Are they insisting on HSM from day 1?
Maya: They prefer HSM eventually but will accept customer-managed KMS for pilot if we can promise telemetry and a migration path. Pilot target: p95 200ms, p99 goal later.
Alex: Infra: we can provision a dedicated GPU pool and KMS connector. HSM onboarding (attestation, rotation, export) is a separate vendor integration ~3-4w. Network peering + IAM scoping also required.
Sam: Runtime: p95 200ms for 2k-token gen is plausible with tuned model variant + quantization + cache warmup, but p99 150ms is unrealistic for current models. Need experiments.
Jordan: Security: customer wants evidence of key custody controls. For pilot we can use customer-managed KMS and provide audit logs; HSM attestation is a post-pilot deliverable. Legal needs to review claims.
Lee: Product: propose pilot acceptance criteria: 1) p95 <= 200ms under pilot traffic; 2) quality delta <= 2% on eval set; 3) audit logs available; 4) infra runbook completed.
Priya: Sales asked for pilot in ~8 weeks. If we parallelize infra, runtime, and security work we might make it. HSM would push timeline.
Maya: Agreed. Proposed MVP scope: customer-managed KMS, dedicated capacity, soft SLA (p95), telemetry + rollback plan. HSM and hard p99 SLA post-pilot.
Sam: I'll run latency matrix and quantization A/B tests this sprint. ETA initial results: 10 business days.
Alex: I'll open infra tickets for VPC peering, dedicated pool, KMS connector, and audit-log path. ETA: 8-10 business days.
Jordan: I'll produce a compliance gap doc and coordinate with Legal. ETA: EOW next week.
Priya: I'll draft the pilot statement of work and ask the customer to accept the pilot constraints (no HSM attestation).
deploy-bot: Ticket created: PROD-8420 "Tenant KMS pilot prep" assigned to Alex.
Maya: Risk list: perf regressions after quantization, HSM delays, and customer dissatisfaction with soft SLA. Mitigations: eval harness, model fallback, clear customer comms.
Lee: I'll run the quality regression harness when Sam finishes configs. Link to evals: https://redwood.internal/evals/tenant-kms (internal).
Maya: Action recap: Maya -> legal/exec alignment; Priya -> customer SOW; Alex -> infra tickets & runbook; Sam -> runtime experiments; Jordan -> compliance gap doc; Lee -> evals. Weekly sync next Tue.
